author: Mod Azanna
quote:
High Level Thieving Rebalance: Coldfix February 19th 
Good Afternoon Scapers’ @RuneScape News 

We have just completed a coldfix to implement the proposed Thieving updates we mentioned on Tuesday in our Thieving Rebalance: High-Level Pickpocketing Update newspost.  

Below you will find the patch notes for these changes but in general they should enable an extended and more predictable pickpocketing experience at the higher levels.

* Improved the AFK-ability of pickpocketing in line with the recent blog.
** Improved the level bonus for all targets across 3 brackets. The level bonus gives you an extra "X-level boost" for your next X pickpockets
** For low-level targets (level 1 - 30) your initial level bonus has been increased from 10 -> 15 for 10 picks.
** For mid-level targets (level 31 - 50) your initial level bonus has been increased from 10 -> 20 for 10 picks.
** For high-level targets (level 100+) your initial level bonus has been increased from 10 -> 25 for 25 picks.
* A new effect has been added to the Crystal Mask spell that will reset the players’ pickpocketing target when used.
** When pickpocketing the player's success % goes down with each attempt after X guaranteed attempts. If the player goes under 100% and then reuses this spell they correctly jump back up to above the 100% threshold as expected.
* After the buffer your chance of being caught starts to reduce, this has been reduced from 1 level per time to 0.25
** This will ultimately prolong the amount of AFK that players can have from the current 2-3 mins to around 4-6 mins, lining up with the Crystal Mask time of 5 minutes and what players have suggested is a good AFK time.
* Added a message when you can first start to be spotted (your chance has gone below 100%) so that it is clear to players that they should try to find a new target (or renew Crystal Mask)
** Also added a sound effect.
* Adjusted Sticky Fingers Archaeology relic to be less harmful to the player
** Currently it makes the player pickpocket 50% faster for 33% less XP. In the new system this means you fail much faster too.
** We're going to make the relic reduce the above threshold to 0.17 per attempt instead which should balance the speed aspect to still allow a decent amount of afk.
* Reduced Pickpocketing XP for targets introduced with 120 Thieving, reflecting the changes outlined in the blog (approximately a 30% XP reduction).
** Loot rates have not currently been updated but as mentioned in the blog they will be adjusted in the near future.
* Resolved an issue with the Thieves’ Guild doors being unusable.
